meta.name: The Judge from Hell
meta.description: A cruel and vicious judge, who wields power only for herself, meets a warm and cheerful detective who puts the victims first.

videos.title: EPISODE 1
videos.overview: Demon Justitia possesses the body of Judge Kang Bitna and must punish criminals.

videos.title: EPISODE 2
videos.overview: Daon receives unexpected news while protecting Minjeong. Bitna's first infernal trial begins.

videos.title: EPISODE 3
videos.overview: While reveling in her string of executions, Bitna encounters someone unexpected.

videos.title: EPISODE 4
videos.overview: Bitna's infernal trial begins once again for Bae Jayeong's misdeeds. "Bad adults must be punished."

videos.title: EPISODE 5
videos.overview: While trailing Bitna, Daon finds himself at a secret demons' meeting. A horrific incident occurs.

videos.title: EPISODE 6
videos.overview: "Why do you keep interfering?" Will Bitna escape Daon and conclude her infernal trial?

videos.title: EPISODE 7
videos.overview: Soyeong suspects serial killer J is back. Meanwhile, Daon remains suspicious about Bitna's identity.

videos.title: EPISODE 8
videos.overview: Soyeong disappears. Bitna worries for Daon but concludes Choi Wonjoong's infernal trial as a demon.

videos.title: EPISODE 9
videos.overview: Daon vows revenge against serial killer J and joins forces with demon Bitna.

videos.title: EPISODE 10
videos.overview: Detective Jang's true identity is uncovered. Bitna encounters emotions she's never wanted to face.

videos.title: EPISODE 11
videos.overview: Bitna loses her powers for breaking the rules but still heads to Jaegeol's home to uncover J.

videos.title: EPISODE 12
videos.overview: A body is found in a burned car, and the truth is revealed. Who is J?

videos.title: EPISODE 13
videos.overview: Finally, J's trial begins. At a crossroads, Bitna must make a life-or-death choice.
